Definition: A control that holds several panels in the same space and shows one of them at a time.
A labeled button in a tab pane's tab bar. Choosing a tab shows the panel that belongs to it.
The row of tabs along the top of a tab pane.
The content that a tab shows when it is chosen. It can be a single item or a panel holding many controls.
An object that a program asks to be told when something happens. A TabChangeListener is told when a tab opens or closes.
